en: Dependent on a state cognizable by some [consciousness], a state not cognizable by any [consciousness] arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state cognizable by some [consciousness], a state not cognizable by any [consciousness] and not cognizable by some [consciousness] arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state cognizable by some [consciousness], states both not cognizable by any [consciousness] and not cognizable by some [consciousness] arise...
They arise by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a state cognizable by someone, a state not cognizable by anyone arises by way of the root condition … three.
Dependent on a state both cognizable by someone and not cognizable by anyone, a state not cognizable by anyone arises by way of the root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root-cause condition, there are nine. (In all cases, there are nine.
The Minor Intermediate Dyads are completed.
